To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the visual gist attributes of a video can be classified as people, objects, actions, and backgrounds, and that people are the most salient visual gist attributes of the videos.
people tend to use visual gist attributes such as people, objects, and actions to recognize videos.

the visual gist of a video is determined by a set of visual attributes, which can be categorized as people, objects, actions, and backgrounds; the gist of the video can be inferred by a small number of key frames; the gist is a function of the content of the video; the gist is also a function of the viewer's knowledge and expectations; and the gist is also influenced by the viewer's attention and memory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: 1) How do people make use of a few key frames to make sense of a whole video?

how the visual gist in people's minds is related to the content of the video, how people make sense of the video based on the visual gist and the implications of the findings to the video retrieval and interface designs.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the subjects were mainly concerned with people, objects and action.
people tend to focus more on people, objects and action than other visual elements in the fast forward surrogate.
people use a variety of visual gist attributes to make sense of a given video and the visual gist attributes used by different subjects are different.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the subjects used the visual gist attributes in different combinations and the gist attributes they chose were highly correlated with their selection processes.
the visual gist is composed of a set of attributes and their corresponding frequencies, which can be used for video retrieval and key-frame selection.
people's understanding of the video is based on a few visual attributes, but the attributes vary among subjects and the variations are correlated with their viewing experience.
The main takeaway from our work is that
visual gist is a multi-faceted concept and it can be represented by a combination of attributes, such as "people", "objects" and "actions" in a video.

the gist attributes are not only the visual elements that are important for the subjects to make sense of a digital video but also the elements that can be used to represent a digital video in the video retrieval and interface designs.
visual gist can be used as an indicator to measure the effectiveness of key-frame selection.
